mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, request_id, job_code, biz_date, dependency_snapshot::text as dependency_snapshot, launch_payload::text as launch_payload, wait_status, attempt_count, last_not_ready_reason, last_checked_at, created_at, updated_at, released_at, timeout_alerted_at
mapper.insert: insert into batch.job_dependency_waiting_launch (tenant_id, request_id, job_code, biz_date, dependency_snapshot, launch_payload) values (#{tenantId}, #{requestId}, #{jobCode}, #{bizDate}, #{dependencySnapshot}::jsonb, #{launchPayload}::jsonb) on conflict (tenant_id, request_id) do nothing
mapper.select: select from batch.job_dependency_waiting_launch where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and wait_status = 'WAITING' order by updated_at, id limit #{limit}

select tenant_id, request_id, job_code, biz_date, dependency_snapshot::text as dependency_snapshot, wait_status, attempt_count, last_not_ready_reason, last_checked_at, created_at, updated_at, timeout_alerted_at from batch.job_dependency_waiting_launch where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and (#{waitStatus} is null or wait_status = #{waitStatus}) and (#{jobCode} is null or job_code = #{jobCode}) order by updated_at desc, id desc limit #{limit}

select count(*) as "waitingCount", coalesce(max(extract(epoch from (current_timestamp - created_at))), 0)::bigint as "oldestAgeSeconds" from batch.job_dependency_waiting_launch where wait_status = 'WAITING'
mapper.update: update batch.job_dependency_waiting_launch set attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, last_not_ready_reason = #{reason}, last_checked_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and request_id = #{requestId} and wait_status = 'WAITING'

update batch.job_dependency_waiting_launch set timeout_alerted_at = #{alertedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and request_id = #{requestId} and wait_status = 'WAITING' and timeout_alerted_at is null
